claims.scope: General exact One(result) admission and shared-substitution preservation; closed javac guard/substitution extraction; 675 finite type instances with nested types, construction and mismatch controls. General source-leaf sequence preservation for admitted homogeneous dependent chains, Seq carrier and positional replay checks; compiler-resolved producer/verifier controls and bounded direct observations. Independent type, arity, source and certificate authority obligations remain separate.

General chain length and per-payload occurrence-count preservation; direct repeated-operand construction and certificate replay controls. Payload equality denotes complete operand identity, never merely type equality.

General arbitrary-arity exact-visit validation, complete ordered edge contract, and no neighboring-bucket fallback; compiler-extracted CALL-specific controls and bounded malformed/positive execution cases. Payload/authority issuance and Java integer/resource limits remain explicit dependencies.

General ordered capture/validation with repeated payloads and finite actual parser/MASG/certification-source IR/certified argument observations. This is retained-source boundary conformance, not universal parser refinement or optimizer occurrence survival.
